title: de.hubtask.installation.workspace.deletion_cancelled.v1
description: A requested deletion was cancelled; the workspace returns to the status it had. An installation event: it is pushed to the installation's subscriptions and read from `GET /admin/events`, never offered to a workspace. Identifiers and states only, never content. The wire format is a CloudEvent 1.0 in structured JSON; `tenantid` is the workspace the event is about. Fields may be added; removing or reinterpreting one requires a .v2 delivered alongside .v1 for at least two minor releases.

id.description: UUIDv7. Stable across delivery attempts, so a consumer deduplicates on it (at-least-once delivery).

subject.description: `workspace/<id>` - the workspace the event is about.

receivedat.description: When the server learned of the event. The same instant as `time` for an event raised online; for a change a device made offline and pushed later, `time` is the device's bounded moment and this is the push's. A rule with a time condition evaluates this one.

tenantid.description: The workspace the event is about.

actorid.description: Absent when the system itself acts. No label: an event leaves the installation, and a name is personal data a subscriber does not need in order to react.

onbehalfof.description: The principal an automation rule or an agent runs as.

correlationid.description: Everything that came out of one original action carries the same value. A root event is its own correlation.

causationid.description: The event that caused this one. Absent for an action a person took.

pushid.description: The push a device brought the change in with, and absent for a change made online. Deliveries of one push about one subject and of one type are collapsed to one, with the last event's payload.

causationdepth.description: Distance from the original action. The rule engine stops at 5 and marks the run ABORTED_LOOP.

workspace.description: The workspace's whole current state, on every installation event. A receiver keeps the event with the highest version and needs no ordering.

id.description: The workspace. The platform knows it from provisioning; the one identifier left once the workspace is gone.

external_reference.description: The platform's own reference, as it set it. Null when none is set, and removed from every kept event at the purge.

status.description: DELETED only on the deleted event: the workspace is gone.

plan.description: The plan's short name, which never changes; null without a plan.

version.description: The workspace's version, which only grows. An event that changes nothing on the workspace carries the version as it stands.
